title: Wildcard Site Extensibility — Wiring the 'Other' Category as the Launcher for External Sites
status_note_20260915: Traced the real code path (saveNewProject -> shouldUseLaunchCard/shouldLaunchExternally -> loadProject) and confirmed the underlying mechanism this contract describes already works: the 'other' category tab and add-project form exist and are wired up, and a project with no explicit embed field already renders as a launch card (window.open with noopener,noreferrer) rather than an iframe for any cross-origin URL - exactly the embed:false-by-default behavior this contract calls for, with no new code required for that part. Also fixed 2 real accessibility gaps found in the process (the category buttons had no ARIA tab semantics; the add-project form's two inputs had no accessible name) - both are new findings, not part of the original 130-finding audit. NOT satisfied yet, per this contract's own required_evidence: no live authenticated browser test was run (no screenshot/read_page capture of an actual cat:"other" entry rendering as a launch card), and the 'how to add a new external site' documentation this contract calls for did not exist until this note prompted writing docs/DAVEAI_WILDCARD_SITES_GUIDE_20260915.md just now - read that for the actual how-to. Do not mark this contract done until someone actually clicks through it live and confirms.
priority_note: Fourth priority, per the owner's explicit ordering: chat, then menus/tabs, then games, then wildcard sites. Roadmap: 'Once Phase 3's registry is real and singular, wire the existing unused "other" category into the launcher UI as the place your additional sites go, with embed:false as the default for anything you don't control.' This is an explicit, textual dependency on CT-003 in the roadmap doc itself, not an inferred one.
audit_status_note: A section-by-section bug audit of the live production source (vps/daveai-ui-v6.html, brain_llm.py, CSS, and infra scripts) produced 133 candidate findings; 83 were independently confirmed real. The other 50 are NOT confirmed-false — they are pending re-verification after an unrelated rate-limit interruption stopped that re-check pass partway through. Treat any finding not explicitly marked confirmation_status='confirmed' or 'verified-in-this-contract' below as unresolved, not cleared. No consolidated ledger of all 133 findings exists in this repository as of 2026-09-15; no items were specifically flagged for this phase beyond what is described below.
summary: Make it easy to keep adding the owner's other sites to daveai.tech as first-class launcher entries, using groundwork that already exists but is not yet wired up: an unused 'other' catalog category and an embed:false rendering mode that already shows a launch card instead of an iframe.
background: The roadmap doc identifies existing, unused groundwork for this goal: the catalog schema already has a 'web | apps | games | other' category field, and setting embed:false on a catalog entry already makes the UI render it as a launch card instead of an iframe — exactly the presentation you want for a site you do not control and should not attempt to frame. During contract-kit preparation (2026-09-15), the 'other' category's UI filter button was independently confirmed to already exist in vps/daveai-ui-v6.html, but zero catalog entries currently use cat:"other" — the category is wired into the filter UI but has no content and, per the roadmap, no launcher wiring behind it yet. This contract depends entirely on CT-003 landing first: wiring a new, permanent category into a catalog mechanism that is still split five ways would either have to be done five times or would immediately drift, which is exactly the failure mode CT-003 exists to remove.

Add at least one real test entry tagged cat:"other" with embed:false to the canonical catalog, and confirm it appears correctly under the 'other' filter as a launch card, not an iframe.
Confirm an entry with embed:true still renders as an iframe as before (no regression to existing embed behavior).

Write down (in this contract's evidence, and/or a short doc if none exists) the exact steps required to add a new external 'wildcard' site going forward, so the owner or a future agent does not have to re-derive this.
Remove or replace the test entry once verified, unless the owner wants it to remain as a real, permanent example.
Gather required_evidence for every change before writing a completion report.
Check every definition_of_done line item against your own evidence before declaring any of them done.
